title: Mount Fuji is pictured from the International Space Station
author: NASA/JSC
description: iss074e0459411 (April 10, 2026) --- Mount Fuji is pictured from the International Space Station as it orbited 264 miles above the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Sendai, Japan. Though Mount Fuji is considered an active volcano and is monitored closely 24 hours a day, it has not had a major eruption since 1707. Credit: NASA/Chris Williams
